sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Em7]Go, meet Him [A7]as He cometh, [D]with hallelujahs clear.
[A]The marriage [D]feast is waiting, [A]the gates [E7]wide open stand;
[F#m]Up, up, [Bm]you heirs [A]of glory, [E7]the Bride-groom [A]is at hand.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [D]You saints [A]who here in [Bm]patience your cross [D]and suff'rings bore,
[Em7]Shall live and [A7]reign forever, when [D]sorrow is no more.
[A]Upon the [D]throne of glory [A]the Lamb [E7]you shall behold,

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Em7]Arise, O sun [A7]so longed for, [D]o'er this benighted sphere!
[A]With hearts [D]and hands uplifted, [A]we plead, O [E7]Lord, to see
